registered_claim_authority: One self-contained GitHub Issue #240 CLAIM envelope validated against the current immutable task publication
execution_record_compatibility: research_execution_records/<task-id>/<execution-record-id>.json may preserve/freeze execution provenance but is not a mandatory pre-claim remote write
selection_rule: Use the historical state/priority/leverage/staleness ordering over the merged canonical view; AWAITING_REVIEW and COMPLETE are never selected. A registered CLAIM is accepted when its self-contained envelope matches the current immutable publication and branch/output typing, or when a compatible historical execution record already supplies the same binding.
interaction_budget: Dispatch evaluation is deterministic repository-local/event-input reduction. The contract introduces no periodic status query, CI poll, heartbeat, review poll, or moving-main chase.
